purpose: A row-action group with a limited number of visible icon buttons and an overflow menu.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Normalize maxVisible to a nonnegative whole count and split actions into visible IconButtons and overflow DropdownMenu items.
Give each visible action its label as an accessible name. Preserve disabled per action and map destructive overflow intent explicitly.
host: Supply stable ids, meaningful names and action callbacks. Own permissions and pending/error behavior.
Account for focus behavior when actions disappear after record updates.

requirements.statement: Normalize maxVisible to a nonnegative whole count and split actions into visible IconButtons and overflow DropdownMenu items.
Give each visible action its label as an accessible name. Preserve disabled per action and map destructive overflow intent explicitly.
Stop click and keydown propagation at the group boundary before calling optional group handlers, so cell actions do not trigger a parent row activation.
Supply stable ids, meaningful names and action callbacks. Own permissions and pending/error behavior.
Account for focus behavior when actions disappear after record updates.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No async pending guard, confirmation, data mutation or rollback is provided.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
